content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], Thank you for your suggestion. Could I ask for a bit more advice? I noticed that neither the analog amplifier output nor the math instructions are showing any decimal values. Is it possible to get more precise output including decimals, or do analog flags/analog outputs only work with whole numbers? Thanks a lot.

The [product_name] controller uses 16-bit signed integers (ranging from -32,768 to 32,767), so it doesn't work with decimal values. Additionally, the F/I converter you're using also doesn't provide decimal precision for your application. It converts a floating point number (32-bit or 64-bit) into a 16-bit integer, which is its intended function.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered issues with decimal precision when working with analog outputs and math instructions on the [product_name] controller. The limitation stems from the device's use of 16-bit signed integers, requiring all values to be whole numbers and preventing accurate decimal representation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] controller to support analog output and math instruction results with decimal fractions, instead of rounding all outputs to integers.
